recentItems.title: TANKER EXPLOSION: Unidentified Projectile Strikes Ship Off Saudi Coast Near Al Jubail!
recentItems.description:
A commercial tanker was hit by an unidentified projectile approximately 68 nautical miles off the coast of Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia. Confirmed by the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), the critical incident prompted an immediate safety evacuation of all crew members. International naval defense forces have launched a high-priority investigation to secure vital Persian Gulf trade lanes.

recentItems.title: OWAISI ATTACKS INDIA BLOC: AIMIM Chief Calls Opposition "Elite Club" Over SIR Row!
recentItems.description:
AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi launched a scathing attack on the opposition INDIA bloc, labeling it an "elite club" that lacks a monopoly over national agitations. Rejecting political marginalization amid intense protests against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise, Owaisi asserted that AIMIM is fighting the electoral roll row relentlessly across legal, political, and public fronts.
